Cell cycle and HIF-1 related gene expression alteration in thyroid cell lines under microgravity

KEGG pathway enrichment analysis of differentially expressed genes in SNU-80 and BCPAP cells cultured under simulated microgravity compared to normal gravity. (A) KEGG enrichment analysis for upregulated DEGs in SNU-80 and BCPAP cell lines under microgravity. (B) KEGG enrichment analysis for downregulated DEGs in SNU-80 and BCPAP cell lines under microgravity
